detail: Full summary: No 1.23-era eval baseline exists: test/eval/results/regression-baseline.json and latest.json both date to 2026-03-02 (plugin 1.1.3 era, synthetic 0.8848 / holdout 0.9951, 100% effective pass rate). The v2 ship-gate comparison is therefore v2-tree vs March baseline + absolute scorer thresholds; a true 1.23 comparison requires checking out the v1.23.0 tag and re-running the suite there.
